27/G.goal: Explain the optical and physiological foundations of visual perception and their relevance to XR headset, rendering, camera placement, and tracking design.
27/G.achieves: Gives the learner foundational knowledge for understanding XR visual experience, human factors, and system development with confidence.

27/O1.goal: Explain the optical and color-perception foundations of visual perception and why they are relevant to XR headset, rendering, camera placement, and tracking design.
27/O1.achieves: Provides the learner with the basis for understanding later XR rendering, tracking, and headset design choices and for evaluating visual system requirements.

27/O2.goal: Describe how the structure and photoreceptors of the human eye process visible light to produce central, peripheral, and blind-spot vision.
27/O2.achieves: Gives the learner the physiological foundation needed to understand XR visual experience and human factors related to perception.
